shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- src ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | sed -n '1,120p' && printf '\\n--- docs ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name 'INDEX.md' -o -name 'README.md' \\) -print"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/uikit@''^7.44.0 @gravity-ui/markdown-editor && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | sed -n '"'1,140p' && printf '\\n--- docs files ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor -maxdepth 4 -type f \\( -name 'INDEX.md' -o -name 'README.md' \\) -print"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- components docs index ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/components -maxdepth 4 -type f \\( -name 'INDEX.md' -o -name 'README.md' \\) -print; printf '\\n--- markdown API types ---\\n'; rg -n \"declare (const|function|class) (MarkdownEditor|Editor)|interface .*EditorProps|type .*EditorProps|mode|initial\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/*.d.ts | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"useMarkdownEditor|EditorOptions|mode|initial|Markup|Wysiwyg\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/*.d.ts | head -180; printf '\\n--- FormRow docs ---\\n'; rg -n -C 8 \"FormRow\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- component types ---\\n'; rg -n \"declare (const|function) FormRow|interface FormRowProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/index.d.ts; rg -n \"useMarkdownEditor|MarkdownEditorView\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -60; printf '\\n--- package tree ---\\n'; npm ls @diplodoc/transform @gravity-ui/components @gravity-ui/uikit react"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts; rg -n \"type UseMarkdownEditorProps|interface UseMarkdownEditorProps|initialContent|mode\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common/*.d.ts | head -100; printf '\\n--- form row ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/FormRow/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/App.tsx')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(' className=\"form\" q=\"markdown-form\"', ' className=\"form\"')
s = s.replace('gapColumn={2}', 'gap={2}')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/ className=\"form\" q=\"markdown-form\"/ className=\"form\"/; s/gapColumn={2}/gap={2}/' src/App.tsx && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- deps ---\\n'; node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies)\""

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i '1d; /import {/{ /markdown-editor/{ N; s/  MarkdownEditorView,\\n  useMarkdownEditor,/  MarkdownEditorView,\\n  useMarkdownEditor,/ } }' src/App.tsx
sed -i 's/    setSavedDescription(editor ? editor.getValue() : description);/    setSavedDescription(editor.getValue());/' src/App.tsx
